item.title: Father of US-based Hong Kong activist convicted under national security law
item.description: A Hong Kong court has convicted the father of a U.S.-based activist for attempting to deal with his daughter's financial assets.

item.title: Bulls' Collin Sexton fined $35,000 for inappropriate hand gesture during loss to Nets
item.description: The NBA has fined Chicago Bulls guard Collin Sexton $35,000 for making an inappropriate hand gesture during a game.

item.title: Wisconsin rallies from 12-point second-half deficit for 92-90 overtime win over No. 8 Illinois
item.description: Nick Boyd scored 25 points and John Blackwell had 24 to lead Wisconsin to a 92-90 overtime victory over No. 8 Illinois.

item.title: Asian shares advance after weak US retail data weigh on Wall Street
item.description: Shares are moderately higher in Asia after U.S. stocks drifted to a mixed finish following a discouraging report on how much money U.S. retailers made during the holidays.

item.title: Sharp makes 8 3s and sets school career record as No. 3 Houston drubs Utah 66-52
item.description: Emanuel Sharp set a school record for career 3-pointers and scored 27 points to lead No. 3 Houston over Utah 66-52.

item.title: Isiah Evans scores 21 points and Cameron Boozer adds 17 to lead No. 4 Duke over Pittsburgh, 70-54
item.description: Isiah Evans scored 21 points on 8-of-10 shooting, including 5 for 6 on 3-pointers, and No. 4 Duke pulled away in the second half to defeat Pittsburgh 70-54.

item.title: Lawrence High School employee charged for allegedly touching student inappropriately
item.description: A student reported to an administrator after "being inappropriately touched by a school employee," Nassau police said in a news release.

item.title: Crowded Democratic field in California governor's race might provide a rare opening for the GOP
item.description: How many Democrats are too many.

item.title: Arizona State uses late surge to beat Oklahoma State 85-76
item.description: Arizona State defeats Oklahoma State 85-76, thanks to a late 9-0 surge.

item.title: San Francisco parents scramble as teachers strike leaves 50,000 students out of school
item.description: Connor Haught is juggling work and child care as San Francisco faces a teachers strike with no end in sight.
